question_text:
What may be the result of too little coolant in the engine?
Too little coolant can

options.text: - lead to overheating of the engine
- lead to an increase of fuel consumption

correct_answers.text: - lead to overheating of the engine

comment: Too little coolant can lead to engine damage and should always be checked by you. Another consequence is the engine overheating. Make sure you have enough coolant.

question_text:
You are in a traffic jam, driving at walking speed. When is the least wear exerted on the clutch of your manual transmission vehicle?
When I

options.text: - drive in a low gear without pressing the clutch if at all possible
- drive slowly with the clutch slipped

correct_answers.text: - drive in a low gear without pressing the clutch if at all possible

comment: Engage the clutch fully to avoid unnecessary wear on the clutch. Choose a gear in which you can coast without using the clutch and accelerator.
